source.described_commit_note: This append-only packet records the first post-fix CI metadata failure and recovery; its commit triggers the corrected PR-body gate.

scope: Recover the PR metadata gate without changing product code, tests, contracts, dependencies, or review behavior.

l1_milestones: cross-cutting E1-B status shell (no promotion claimed)
quality_mapping.track_2_relevance: Keeps public PR evidence machine-checkable and linked to the exact local-only review fix.

failure.message: FAIL AC-22: no non-empty public evidence item
failure.cause: The PR body used Markdown-bold `**Test/fixture result:**`; the public checker requires the colon to be followed directly by whitespace and a non-empty value.
failure.code_status: All preceding static/public QA steps passed; this was a PR-body metadata format failure, not a source or test failure.

actions: Changed the field to `Test/fixture result: 89/89 Vitest; ...` on one line.
Updated PR review state, exact review-fix implementation/evidence SHAs, evidence packet path, test counts, and the three owner constraints.
Validated the live PR body with `qa/scripts/check_pr_metadata.py` before triggering a new synchronize event.
recovery.local_result: PASS AC-22: PR quality-contract metadata is present

privacy_review.notes: Only public PR URLs, commit identities, aggregate test results, and the public checker message are retained.
